items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: I was still kind of back listening to, you know, my Joni Mitchell records and Bob Dylan before I got deeper into jazz.

ctx.x: Do you and Larry comment on each other’s music and composing and so forth.

Yes we sure do. He’s my worst critic and I’m his worst critic. Larry’s — but you know what it’s really, really great because yeah — his taste — he started working at a record store when he was like 15 years old and he’s attended way more jazz performances than I have because he was like in his late teens he was already going out and driving to Buffalo with people to hear — to hear Freddie Hubbard or to hear some of the greats that were playing. And I was still kind of back listening to, you know, my Joni Mitchell…
Does the — are you asked like I’m about to ask you — about the women in jazz, the state of women in jazz?
